WASHINGTON, D.C. – U.S. Senator Elissa Slotkin (D-MI) released the following statement regarding her no vote on proceeding on the Clarity Act, a large package regulating the crypto industry.  

“Today, I voted no on the Clarity Act, legislation meant to regulate cryptocurrency in America. 

“The ethics provisions in this bill are simply too thin. President Trump, his children, and his Cabinet are making billions of dollars in the crypto space, in part from bilking everyday Americans out of their hard-earned money.
